population.publicDispositionDigestMethod: SHA-256 of the 444 sorted public recordId values joined by a line feed, with no trailing line feed.
population.completenessBoundary: Two terminal traversals with distinct scroll cadences recovered the same 444 record identities; every recovered record received a public-safe disposition. This is not a native Meta export, deletion history, lifetime total, or proof that no historical post is missing.

separateControls.contentControl: A separately recovered content-control comparison did not expose a historic human-level publisher field and is not used as the 2017-2021 timeline denominator.
separateControls.controlBoundary: Page-level action controls identify the NYC Artist Coalition publishing identity, not the human who created each post.

stakeholderRouting.boundary: Rule-matched mentions and links document public addressing and routing. They do not establish that a stakeholder saw, authored, endorsed, replied to, or acted on a post.

visibleInteractionSnapshot.boundary: These are mutable July 14, 2026 interface floors, not historical analytics, unique people, reach, attendance, conversion, endorsement, causality, or impact.

destinationInventory.boundary: Posted URLs are source-discovery and action-routing leads. They do not automatically corroborate linked claims or establish authorship, readership, conversion, partnership, or impact.

publicSafety.retained: Stable record ID, sequence, form, anonymous theme and stakeholder classifications, classification counts, a visible-interaction boolean, and unlinkable interaction-value frequencies.
publicSafety.withheld: Raw post text, comments, names, post URLs, per-record metrics, administrator state, authentication material, relationship data, media, and unstable or sensitive action routes.
